LocalizedProperties.ProductDescription:
Be the leader of red and blue wobblers from ancient lands, spooky places and fantasy worlds. Watch them fight in simulations made with the wobbliest physics system ever created.

When you grow tired of the 100+ wobblers at your disposal you can make new ones in the unit creator.

You can also send your wobblers to fight your friends or strangers in online multiplayer!
LocalizedProperties.ShortDescription: Be the leader of wobblers from ancient lands, spooky places and fantasy worlds. Watch them fight in simulations made with the wobbliest physics system ever created, make your own wobblers in the unit creator and send your army off to fight your friends in multiplayer.

LocalizedProperties.MinimumNotes: Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system;Processor: Intel Core i5-2400 @ 3.1 GHz or AMD FX-6300 @ 3.5 GHz or equivalent;Memory: 8 GB RAM;Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 670 or AMD R9 270 (2GB VRAM with Shader Model 5.0 or better);Storage: 6 GB available space
LocalizedProperties.RecommendedNotes: Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system;Processor: Intel Core i7-4770 @ 3.4 GHz or AMD Ryzen 5 1600 @ 3.2 GHz or equivalent;Memory: 8 GB RAM;Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 970 or AMD R9 290X (4GB VRAM with Shader Model 5.0 or better);Storage: 10 GB available space
